 Oral Order

In this petition, petitioners have sought for the following relief:-
"(a) Allow this Criminal Petition and quash the FIR and Complaint in Crime No.103/2023 registered by respondent No.1 Mangalore Women P.S.(on the file of the learned 3rd J.M.F.C. III Court, Mangalore) for the alleged offences under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 526 and 34 of I.P.C.; under Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and under Section 4 of the Muslim Women (protection of Rights on Marriage)
Act, 2019; produced at Document No.1 and 2.
(b) Grant such other relief or reliefs as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit in the facts and circumstances of the case, in the interest of justice and equity."
2. Learned counsel for the petitioners - accused Nos.1 to 4 and learned counsel for respondent No.2 - complainant have filed Memorandum of Compromise Petition duly signed by the petitioner No.1,
2nd respondent and their respective counsel and the same is taken on record.

"Memorandum of Compromise Petition under Section 359 r/w 528 of BSNN, 2023 The Petitioners and the respondent No.2 above named most respectfully submits as follows:
1.
